title: Geschwindigkeitskontrollen im Rahmen der zweiten ROADPOL-Aktionswoche „Speedweek“ 2026 – Polizei Berlin zieht Bilanz

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin police reported results of the ROADPOL Speedweek speed checks from 3 to 9 August 2026 at 247 locations, recording 12,413 speeding violations. 61 drivers exceeded the limit by more than 31 km/h and face at least a one-month driving ban.
